threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still wait for the bus in the rain instead of checking the Overground app. It's like picking a fight with the weather.
Caught the 59 late last night, a guy in a full dinosaur costume singing to himself. Only in Brixton would that seem normal.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I was home when I saw a guy in a full suit casually picking up a döner at 3 a.m., like it was the most normal thing in the world.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you grab a currywurst at 3 AM from a stand where the chef looks like he just stepped out of a Berlin film. It's an experience.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here if they can casually name the BART line that just delayed them, while others are still figuring out what BART is.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught an overheated bus idling on Hyde, driver waiting for a coolant check while panhandlers offered snacks to the passengers. Classic San Francisco.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí, but it's the tiny plaça with a bar named after a 70s film that really captures the soul of the place.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they awkwardly order a café amb llet – it's either too milky or too strong. The locals know the perfect balance.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think shops close at 6.30pm. Good luck finding a pint after 10, mate!
Saw a bloke on the 2 bus last night, loudly debating with a lamppost about the best chicken shop in Brixton. No one batted an eyelid.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was truly living here when I found myself debating the best Kebab spot at 2 AM with a random guy in the U-Bahn.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find spontaneous techno parties in the middle of the street, complete with makeshift bars and a diverse crowd dancing till dawn.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know that 'BART's down' means you better set aside an extra hour for your commute, not just a minor inconvenience.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today with a guy in a full tuxedo napping while the rest of us stood. Only in San Francisco do you see that kind of style in chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about the bohemian vibe, but they miss the quiet afternoons when the locals close their windows to escape the noise.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones sipping overpriced smoothies while furiously fumbling with the metro map at the Passeig de Gràcia station.
